name: Products Frequently Bought Together for WooCommerce
author: PI Web Solution

sections.description:
Products Frequently Bought Together for WooCommerce is a powerful plugin that helps you boost your sales by displaying frequently bought together products on your WooCommerce store. By showcasing related products, you can encourage customers to add more items to their cart, increasing your average order value.

The plugin analyzes your store’s order history to identify products that are commonly purchased together. Based on this data, it automatically suggests relevant products to customers when they view their cart.

Key Features

  • Intelligent Order Analysis: The plugin scans your past orders to find patterns and identify products that are frequently bought together.
  • Automatic Recommendations: Automatically displays “Frequently Bought Together” suggestions in the cart based on the items currently in the customer’s cart.
  • Seamless Cart Integration: Recommendations are shown directly in the cart, making it easy for customers to add them to their order.
  • One-Click Add to Cart: Customers can add recommended products to their cart with a single click.
  • Background Processing: The order analysis runs in the background, ensuring that your site’s performance is not impacted.
  • HPOS Compatible: Fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).

How it Works

  1. Analyze Orders: Go to the plugin settings and start the order analysis. The plugin will process your order history to build a database of product associations.
  2. Display Recommendations: When a customer adds a product to their cart, the plugin checks for any associated products.
  3. Boost Sales: If a match is found, the recommended product is displayed in the cart, encouraging the customer to purchase more.

Benefits

  • Increase Average Order Value (AOV): Encourage customers to buy more by suggesting relevant add-ons and complementary products.
  • Automated Cross-Selling: Save time by letting the plugin automatically generate cross-sell recommendations based on real data.
  • Improve User Experience: Help customers find products they might need or want, enhancing their shopping experience.
